figures.caption: Per-LR × per-seed Δ_A = Acc(QA_I)_Ctrl-A − Acc(QA_I)_treated across the 8-LR × 3-seed grid. Dashed line marks the +3 pp M0 threshold; the reproducible double-drop is established at LR 1e-3 (highlighted band); LR 2e-3 is a degenerate regime (treated acc ≈ 0).
